data.desc: PSIG is a long-established global logistics and supply chain solution provider specializing in air freight forwarding, ocean freight forwarding and end-to-end supply chain ancillary services, connecting Asian transportation hubs with the United States and over 140 other global markets. The Company operates its core businesses through two Hong Kong-based operating subsidiaries: Profit Sail Int'l Express (H.K.) Limited and Business Great Global Supply Chain Limited. Additional corporate and operational information is available on the Company's official website: https://www.psi-groups.com/.
